mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_pool (id, name, description, department_code, department_name, namespace, service_account_name, gpu_slots, cpu_cores, memory_gib, max_pods, node_count, allocated_gpu_slots, allocated_cpu_cores, allocated_memory_gib, hardware_type, security_level, gpu_type, job_types, volcano_queue_name, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{departmentCode}, #{departmentName}, #{namespace}, #{serviceAccountName}, #{gpuSlots}, #{cpuCores}, #{memoryGiB}, #{maxPods}, #{nodeCount}, #{allocatedGpuSlots}, #{allocatedCpuCores}, #{allocatedMemoryGib}, #{hardwareType}, #{securityLevel}, #{gpuType}, #{jobTypes}, #{volcanoQueueName}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_pool SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, department_code = #{departmentCode}, department_name = #{departmentName}, gpu_slots = #{gpuSlots}, cpu_cores = #{cpuCores}, memory_gib = #{memoryGiB}, max_pods = #{maxPods}, node_count = #{nodeCount}, allocated_gpu_slots = #{allocatedGpuSlots}, allocated_cpu_cores = #{allocatedCpuCores}, allocated_memory_gib = #{allocatedMemoryGib}, hardware_type = #{hardwareType}, security_level = #{securityLevel}, gpu_type = #{gpuType}, job_types = #{jobTypes}, volcano_queue_name = #{volcanoQueueName}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE resource_pool SET allocated_gpu_slots = #{allocatedGpuSlots}, allocated_cpu_cores = #{allocatedCpuCores}, allocated_memory_gib = #{allocatedMemoryGib}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM resource_pool ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT rp.* FROM resource_pool rp JOIN resource_pool_physical_cluster rppc ON rp.id = rppc.resource_pool_id WHERE rppc.physical_cluster_id = #{physicalClusterId} ORDER BY rp.created_at DESC
SELECT physical_cluster_id FROM resource_pool_physical_cluster WHERE resource_pool_id = #{resourcePoolId}
